ios.desc:
Expirea helps you keep track of the food you already have at home, so you know what to use before it expires.

Scan food packaging, save expiry dates, and build a simple inventory of your fridge, pantry, and freezer. Expirea helps you remember what you bought, what needs to be used soon, and what should not be forgotten in the back of the fridge.

Features:
• Scan product labels and expiry dates
• Save food items to your inventory
• Track what expires soon
• Mark packages as opened when it matters
• Organize food across fridge, pantry, and freezer
• Reduce food waste and save money on groceries
• Estimated value of saved products

Expirea Pro:
• Recipe Ideas — available with an Expirea Pro subscription
• Create Shared Household — available with an Expirea Pro subscription

Expirea is designed for real households: messy labels, different food categories, opened products, and everyday grocery routines.

Whether you want to waste less food, keep your kitchen organized, or simply have a clearer view of what you have at home, Expirea helps you stay on top of your food.
